about: What this file is: the shot check for the people test (assemble_people_test.py, plan 34 part 'People'): which objects make up each figure and prop, so the shot checker lists every figure as a prop (its distance, size on the frame, what it overlaps) and draws its outline (solo/NAME.png), for counting the figures in a painting against the plate. The composing rules were written for the notice corner; here the brazier stands in as the subject. Used by paper-film/blender/shot_facts.py and paper-film/tools/check_shot.py.
subject: brazier
kind_of_shot_note: A crowd: five men round the brazier and six far walkers (the place facts view "still"). A crowd's story box may be wider, rule 4 between figures is replaced by heads at least a head width apart and every figure at least half seen.
accepted_note: Nobody has accepted a problem in this view yet. Add an entry only when a person decides to keep a problem: {"rule": a shot_kind_profiles rule name or the report's rule words, "things": [groups] (optional), "reason", "who", "date", "measured" (optional: the number it was accepted at; a problem grown more than 5% past it counts again)}.
